description: Source code for SelfSavingsApiResource class, providing REST API endpoints for self-service savings account operations in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: SelfSavingsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for self-service savings account operations, including retrieval, modification, and listing of savings accounts and related data.

methods.name: retrieveSavings
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific savings account with optional associations.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsTransaction
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific savings account transaction.

methods.name: retrieveAllSavingsAccountCharges
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all charges for a savings account.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific savings account charge.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Provides a template for creating a new savings account.

methods.name: submitSavingsAccountApplication
methods.description: Handles POST request to submit a new savings account application.

methods.name: modifySavingsAccountApplication
methods.description: Handles PUT request to modify an existing savings account.

methods.name: validateAppuserSavingsAccountMapping
methods.description: Validates if the current user has access to the specified savings account.

methods.name: validateAppuserClientsMapping
methods.description: Validates if the current user has access to the specified client.
